title: Verdict Record
description: The single contract every quality runner emits — agent evals, Playwright, k6, drills. One schema is what makes company-wide regression-risk and defect-leakage dashboards possible.

suite.description: e.g. evals, contract, playwright, k6, drill

verdict.description: INFRA = probe/harness infrastructure failed, not the code under test; pages the platform, not the team

fail_closed.description: True if an errored gate blocked (G2). Must be true for any blocking suite.

scores.description: Metric name -> value in [0,1] or raw measure

baseline_diff.description: Metric name -> delta vs committed baseline (negative = regression)

flake_score.description: Re-run variance [0,1]; above threshold auto-quarantines the suite to advisory and pages its owner

cost_usd.description: Cost of this run; cost regressions block like quality regressions

artifacts.description: S3 URIs or paths to detailed logs / audit-lake records
